headline: Bitcoin Options Skew Widens To 29.84 Points From 18.75 Ahead Of The October 23 Expiry
narrative: Bitcoin options skew widened to 29.84 volatility points from 18.75, which means the October 23 put struck at 74,000 is priced 29.84 points above the October 23 call struck at 90,000. The put marked 76.66 implied volatility and the call marked 46.82, so money in this pipe is paying for protection under 74,000 rather than for a move through 90,000. The prior print carried an 18.75 point gap between a 75,000 put and a 92,000 call on the same expiry, which means the premium for downside insurance has widened.
author: jordan
